parameters.content:
## 1. Collect an approved brief
**No credentials or paid AI calls.**
Import into n8n, open Product video brief and test the complete workflow. Use the Production Form URL after publishing in your own instance.
Use non-sensitive inputs. Configure authentication if deploying a private team form; this template does not bundle credentials.

## 2. Validate and review
Checks required text, length and allowed options. Builds three shots: hook, detail, closing. **Fixed planning rules, not AI analysis.**
The review form lets you approve or request revision. Invalid or declined briefs never show the generation handoff. Timings are edit guidance, not supported model durations.

## 3. Copy prompts and generate manually
The ending page offers separate prompts and a complete Markdown pack. Open [Cicadas](https://cicadas.ai/) separately and check available tools, limits and pricing before generating.
**No API calls, auto-prefill, generation, download, assembly or publishing.** The brief is not sent to Cicadas. n8n hosting/execution fees may apply. Supplied product claims require human review.

description:
## What this workflow does
Turn an approved product brief into a three-shot video storyboard, review it in an n8n Form, then copy the prompts for manual use in [Cicadas](https://cicadas.ai/).

For marketers preparing product videos, this template organizes supplied facts into a hook, product-detail shot and closing frame. It uses fixed planning rules, not an AI model, and does not invent product benefits.

## How it works
1. The Form Trigger collects product appearance, audience, approved benefit, setting, call to action, restrictions, video format and planned edit length.
2. A Code node validates required text, length limits and allowed options. Invalid briefs receive correction instructions.
3. A second Form presents the storyboard for human review. Choose approval to see the handoff, or revision to stop.
4. The ending page provides three copyable prompts and a complete Markdown pack. Open Cicadas separately, check current tool options and pricing, then generate manually.

## Setup and limits
Import the workflow and test it with a non-sensitive sample brief. After publishing in your n8n instance, use the Form Trigger's Production URL. No credentials or community nodes are required.

No AI or video API is called. n8n hosting/execution charges may apply; any later Cicadas generation follows its current pricing. Timings describe a planned edit, not supported model durations. There is no automatic prompt transfer, video generation, assembly or download. Review product accuracy and content rights before use.
